# Packslip conformance fixtures

These fixtures are copied byte for byte from the Packslip source repository:
<https://github.com/jdx/packslip>, commit
`c1a14371667b71f35d60454af8baffe2786ef193`.

The included fixtures are `artifact-selection.json`,
`statement-validity.json`, and `tag-versions.json`. They are distributed under
the MIT License; see `LICENSE` for the complete license text.

This subset does not include resource selection cases, signature verification,
or stateful trust rules.
